record.question: Which Ministry has constituted a Committee to implement the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) recently?
options: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
record.explanation: Answer A: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. The NCAP is a Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change programme; its 2019 launch release identifies that ministry. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=187400. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
